test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: To do a certain work, the ratio of the efficiencies of A and B is 7 : 6. Working together, they can complete the same work in 21 days. What part of the same work will be completed by B alone in 26 days?
solution:
**Given:**

The efficiencies of A and B is 7 : 6

They can complete the same work in 21 days

**Concept used:**

Total work = Time × efficiency 

**Calculation:**

Total work = 21 × (7 + 6)

⇒ 273

Now In 26 days B will complete 26 × 6 = 156

So, B completed = 156/273

⇒ 4/7

**∴ B alone will be completed 4/7 part of the work in 26 days**
